title: Output-budget completeness on a seven-function coding task
provenance: PC worker report forwarded through the coordinating thread; no raw response or run log supplied in this repository

configuration.note: Reported token budgets below are ceilings, not measured output token counts.

runs.reported_static_check: AST matched expected; matching criterion not supplied

resource_observation.limitation: Minimum sampled free RAM is not proof of peak-memory headroom or absence of brief spikes.

safety.reason: Worker reports a second model instance exceeds available GPU memory; use a single instance and an agreed idle window for restart-based tests.

interpretation: The lower budget finished sooner by returning an incomplete result; this is not a valid quality-preserving speed win.
192 completed this one task by the reported AST criterion; it is not a universal optimum or proof of semantic correctness.
No decoding throughput can be calculated reliably without actual output-token counts.
Do not infer statistical significance from one reported run per ceiling.
